title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized long-form generation asks a language model to write new text the way a specific user would. The standard recipe, retrieval-augmented generation, places a few of the user's past texts in the prompt but leaves the model to decide what to take from them. We introduce StylePrism, a taxonomy of 28 stylistic aspects in seven categories, and SP-Refine, an inference-time method that makes style extraction an explicit step: the model first fills StylePrism with the user's patterns, quoted evidence, and habits to avoid, then drafts from the user's samples and revises the draft twice against this profile, guided by its own style scores. On the three long-form tasks of LongLaMP with three LLMs, SP-Refine outperforms LongLaMP's retrieval-augmented baseline in 25 of 27 ROUGE and METEOR comparisons, by 10.2% on average and by up to 35.8%. translated_title: 面向个性化长文本生成的显式风格抽取
translated_abstract: 个性化长文本生成要求语言模型以特定用户的方式来撰写新文本。标准方法是检索增强生成，即将用户的部分过往文本放入提示中，但让模型自行决定从中借鉴什么。我们提出了StylePrism，这是一个包含七大类别、共28个风格维度的分类体系，同时提出SP-Refine，一种在推理阶段将风格抽取作为显式步骤的方法：模型首先用用户的写作模式、引用证据和需要避免的习惯来填充StylePrism，然后基于用户的样本起草文本，并在自身风格评分的引导下，依据该风格画像对草稿进行两次修订。在使用三个大语言模型的LongLaMP三个长文本任务上，SP-Refine在27项ROUGE和METEOR对比中的25项上超越了LongLaMP的检索增强基线，平均提升10.2%，最高提升达35.8%。用提取的风格画像对用户自己的文本进行标注表明，StylePrism捕捉到了具体的、可核查的……
tldr: 该论文提出StylePrism风格分类体系（28个风格维度）与SP-Refine推理时方法，将风格抽取变成显式步骤，在LongLaMP三个长文本任务上以平均10.2%的提升显著超越检索增强基线。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces StylePrism, a taxonomy of 28 stylistic aspects, and SP-Refine, an inference-time method making style extraction an explicit step, outperforming retrieval-augmented baselines on LongLaMP long-form tasks by an average of 10.2%.
